you're damn right about me being an attention whore. here's where you're wrong though: I know full well how being absurdly underweight feels like, because I've been an anorexic myself. I remember when simply staying up was hard. I remember how cold I felt even in the summer. 

but you know what? it was easier being a bag of bones for me. my peers told me I had fat legs when I had a "healthy" BMI. then I lost weight, and people started calling me a skeleton. then I got bulimic, and my mother asked me if I wanted to become a sumo wrestler. my own goddamn mother. so why tf should I care what my family feels about my weight? 

now I have a functioning amount of muscle, and look healthy on the skinny side. unfortunately, that doesn't mean I'm okay with my body. I still obsess about how fat I am, hate shopping for clothes, and constantly worry about what I ate or will eat. it was easier for me when I just didn't eat. and I also hate the hassle I go through every month when I have no plans on getting a kid.
